The Learning Super Platform for Smart, Joyful Learning

Classera goes beyond traditional Learning Management System (LMS) to deliver a complete ecosystem with ERP, Fintech Solutions Educational Marketplace and more.

A New Concept in EdTech for Education and Training Sectors

Globally awarded Learning Management System (LMS) Powered by AI, for education and training sector’s growth with gamification, personalization and social Learning for a holistic learning experience.

Make The Learning Experience Unforgettable

Classera excels has three fundamental pillars which contributes immensely in driving innovation and enhancing the educational experience:

AI

Helps in creating dynamic learning and teaching methods powered by AI to increase efficiency with ease.

Gamification

Boosts engagement, offering an interactive and rewarding system through games and advanced educational technology.

Personalization

Tailors the learning experience to meet the student's unique needs, making use of insights based on individual performance.

We Cherish The Voices Of Our Valued Partners

Alex Cho

General Manager, Commercial PCs - HP

We are very enthusiastic about our partnership with Classera to enhance the learning experience for students and teachers, including distant learning. This partnership enables teachers by providing new tools that promote growth and enable excellent learning.

Harb Bou Harb

Chairman of The Educational Sector In The Middle East - Mircosoft

The primary beneficiaries of our collaboration with Classera are the ministries of education and schools that enhance their performance and student outcomes using Classera's smart learning systems, which are compatible with Microsoft technologies. This partnership is crucial for delivering innovative solutions to our shared clients

Muhammad Khaled Al-Khudair

CEO - The National Company For Education - KSA

During the 2020 school closures, Classera ensured a high engagement with a 91% daily login rate from over 15,000 students, effectively supporting their online education through its digital resources. This underscores Classera's role in enhancing educational outcomes during challenging times

Ibrahim Al-Turki

CEO - Ataa Educational Group - KSA

Commends Classera for its adaptability and technological integration that significantly enriches the educational experience. He applauds the platform for its ease of use and effectiveness, supporting its global presence led by innovative Saudi entrepreneurs

Youssef Alkhariji

CEO - Andalus Group - KSA

We have distinguished partnership and strategic strategy that extends for more than 7 years we found it a true partner who shares our vision of digital transformation in Andalus schools after several other experiences, They were the best reliable partner in times of crises like their standing in the previous corona crises, we look forward having an impressive future together

Rashid Alhoussan

CEO - Alhoussan For Training And Learning - KSA

Thanks Classera Middle East for pivotal support in digital education transformation during a five-year partnership, notably during COVID-19 school closures. He praises their role in effectively transitioning from traditional methods to modern e-learning

Dhari Al-Aqeel

CEO - Riyadh Najd Schools - KSA

Underlines their dedication to educational innovation and student development, leading to a partnership with Classera. He highlights Classera's role in modernizing education and meeting international e-learning standards.

Professor Odeh A. Muhawesh

Executive Chairman - Squggle - USA

“The vision to make learning an innovative, fun, and engaging experience while utilizing the latest in technological advancements is a shared one between Squigl and Classera. We, at Squigl, concur with Classera’s view that “Learning never stops”, and that an integrated environment that brings the best of leaning tools is the best approach to serving educators and learners of any age and level.”

Ziad Shatara

CEO - Umniah - Jordan

Umniah is excited to partner with Classera, bringing its expertise in digital education to the global education ecosystem. This collaboration aims to enhance the learning experience by providing innovative, accessible educational tools to improve the creativity and proficiency of learners of all ages

Makke Leppänen

Head Of Partnership - Eduten LTD - Finland

Classera is a respected expert in the education sector. We’ve been delighted with their professional attitude. As the biggest learning platform in Finland, we’re excited to contine our strong partnership with Classera. - makke leppänen, head of partnership, eduten #1 Teaching and Learning Platform. From Finland.

Scott Smith

Vice Present - Global Business Development - Matific - Australia

Matific is excited to collaborate with Classera to advance 21st-century learning skills globally, utilizing their integration to foster dynamic digital learning environments. This partnership is dedicated to enhancing educational experiences and improving academic outcomes, especially in STEM, by providing engaging digital resources for both classroom and remote learning

Domingos Guimaraes

Chief Executive Officer - ubbu - Portugal

“ Classera is much more than a partner, they’ve helped ubbu navigate all the Middle East markets, teaching us how to adapt the content and showing us the way for a perfect cultural integration. Great partners and friends! ”
